title: Conditional credit epochs and SQ-gated upgrade path
creator: Maya Chen
description: Experiment to test whether splitting free trial credits into staggered 'epochs' and tying additional credit unlocks to completion of the enterprise security questionnaire (SQ) improves activation, MQL-to-ARR conversion, and reduces credit hoarding. This experiment targets mid-market buyers who hit usage ceilings during a time-limited trial and are sensitive to both data security and predictable pricing. The proposed approach contrasts a single lump-sum free credit grant (control) with multiple epoched grants and a conditional top-up gated behind SQ completion and a short product activation checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Experiment implemented with three arms (control, epoched-no-gate, epoched-sq-gate) and randomized by account
Backend credit engine supports time-windowed credit grants and conditional unlock API for SQ-completed accounts
Frontend and email UX present clear messaging about epochs, remaining credit, and SQ benefits
Analytics captures cohorted metrics (activation events, tokens consumed per epoch, upgrade conversion, churn) and dashboards are live
No security-sensitive PII is sent to third-party analytics; security review sign-off obtained before rollout
tasks: Final experiment spec and statistical plan (PM) - define target cohorts, minimum detectable effect, and sample size
Backend: implement epoched credit allocation and conditional unlock endpoint (ENG-4728)
Frontend: in-app credit timeline UI and upgrade CTA variants (DES-2140)
Email & notifications: phased reminder cadence per epoch and SQ prompt messaging
Analytics: add event instrumentation (credit_granted, credit_consumed, sq_completed, upgrade_clicked, upgrade_converted) and build Looker dashboard
Security: run quick compliance review on SQ gating flow and storage of questionnaire answers
Run pilot in US-EAST for 2 weeks, validate instrumentation, then expand to EU region
metrics_to_track: Primary: 30-day trial->paid conversion rate by arm
Secondary: tokens consumed per account in first 7/30 days, activation event rate (first 10k tokens), average time to first upgrade click
Tertiary: SQ completion rate, post-conversion churn at 90 days, NPS of trial experience (survey)
